prerequisites.label: Kie.ai API Key (existing fleet credential, shared with Skill 07)
prerequisites.satisfy: KIE_API_KEY is the EXISTING fleet credential Skill 07 (kie-setup) already uses against api.kie.ai. This skill REFERENCES that key for TTS/music/Suno — do NOT mint a new one. Add KIE_API_KEY=<your key> to ~/.openclaw/secrets/.env (chmod 600), then: openclaw config set env.vars.KIE_API_KEY "$KIE_API_KEY". Get your API key from app.kie.ai > Settings > API Keys. Confirm it is SET (never print the value). There is NO separate STT key — there is no STT route at all.
